description: We are HVB Horizon, a student team from Hatipzade Veli Başer Anatolian Imam Hatip High School joining NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are passionate about space, artificial intelligence, coding, robotics, and innovation. Our goal is to develop creative solutions using NASA's open data. We welcome curious, creative, and motivated teammates skilled in programming, data analysis, design, research, and problem-solving. Together, we explore, learn, and innovate!
